purpose.summary: RTT/1 causality-intelligence engine for detecting, mapping, and weaving causal pathways across conceptual, computational, physical, and dimensional regimes.
purpose.detail: The Cross-Domain Causality Weaver identifies causal signatures, computes causal vectors, maps causal fields across RTT regimes (R1–R4), detects causal discontinuities, and provides causal diagnostics for higher-level RTT engines such as Dimensional Resonance Scanner.

ai.ai_keywords: RTT, causality weaver, causal vector, causal field, causal discontinuity, cross-domain causality
ai.ai_purpose: Provide causality-level intelligence for RTT/1 by weaving causal pathways, computing causal vectors, mapping causal fields, and detecting causal discontinuities across conceptual, computational, physical, and dimensional regimes.
ai.ai_operators: CW-Weave, CW-Vector, CW-Field, CW-Signature, CW-Discontinuity, CW-Stabilize
